comparison.objective: Swap two loaded cash-drawer inserts, close the drawer, and avoid spilling coins.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tray lifting, level transport, seating, and drawer closure versus screen tilting intended to move selected contents.
comparison.success_condition: Old insert on mat, counted insert seated with orientation preserved, drawer latched, arms home; excessive tilt/drop gives zero.
comparison.reason: Both preserve loose contents, but this record forbids relative-content motion and tests tray exchange rather than selective sifting.
